statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229, was ordered
The service was to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service was to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
The denial reason code is CO-197
